definition: 1 for any named equipment fault/damage, overheating or protection defect; excludes contact-only and repair-only rows.
limitation: Use for explanation or as a historical label; same-event use leaks the outcome.

definition: Separate multi-label flags for line, jumper, transformer, pole, crossarm, insulator, cutout, breaker, recloser and other listed categories.
limitation: Category counts overlap. Named affected recloser does not prove the failed asset belongs to that recloser.

definition: Count distinct prior event_date + affected recloser days with stated equipment faults. Exclude grid-wide/upstream plant notices from local counts.
availability_rule: Only notices published before prediction-day start in Asia/Manila, with earlier event_date
limitation: Reporting frequency and repeated updates differ from physical incident frequency; do not call this equipment density.

definition: Prior distinct days with broken/burned/damaged power conductors or cables.
availability_rule: Same publication cutoff; exclude current day
limitation: A broken line may be caused by a tree or vehicle, rather than asset deterioration.

definition: Prior distinct days with cut/broken/burning jumpers.
availability_rule: Same publication cutoff; exclude current day
limitation: Proxy for observed connection problems; no conductor age/size is available.

definition: Prior distinct days with damaged, burned, shorted or reportedly exploded transformers.
availability_rule: Same publication cutoff; exclude current day
limitation: Keep reported/probable flags. Cannot infer transformer count, loading or nameplate capacity.

definition: Prior distinct days with broken, rotten, leaning or burned poles/crossarms.
availability_rule: Same publication cutoff; exclude current day
limitation: Preserve collision/tree triggers separately; no pole age/material census exists.

definition: Prior distinct days with damaged insulators, fuse links or cutouts.
availability_rule: Same publication cutoff; exclude current day
limitation: Asset-condition proxy based on reported faults, not an inventory.

definition: Days since the latest previously available fault event; blank plus no-history flag if none.
availability_rule: Latest qualifying event must have been published before prediction
limitation: Do not fill unavailable history with zero.

definition: Prior distinct days with equipment repair/replacement notices, recorded separately from explicit faults.
availability_rule: Same publication cutoff; exclude current day
limitation: A repair notice does not establish an actual component failure.

definition: Prior contacts between power lines and other lines, poles, streetlights, roofs or equipment.
availability_rule: Same publication cutoff; exclude current day
limitation: Interface/clearance proxy; keep vegetation and animal contacts distinct.

definition: Prior days with plant mechanical faults or grid/substation hardware defects.
availability_rule: Only notices available before prediction; use a separate upstream history
limitation: Avoid attributing a generator failure to local recloser hardware.

definition: Number of different equipment fault categories observed in the preceding 365 days.
availability_rule: Same publication cutoff; exclude current day
limitation: May reflect reporting coverage; small-history counts are unstable.

definition: Prior equipment damage days with manually validated vegetation, animal, vehicle or third-party triggers.
availability_rule: Same publication cutoff; exclude current day
limitation: The exported trigger-mention flags are screening aids; validate causal linkage before modeling.

definition: Prior distinct days mentioning auto-reclose or temporary line fault.
availability_rule: Same publication cutoff; exclude current day
limitation: Electrical disturbance history, not proof that a recloser malfunctioned.

definition: Extract voltage only when explicitly tied to the failed asset/location; retain evidence and unknown values.
availability_rule: Use only evidence published before prediction
limitation: Reported 69 kV / 13.8 kV values are partial observations, not a complete network voltage map.

definition: Join asset registry, GIS, commissioning, maintenance and loading records.
availability_rule: Use measurements valid and available at prediction time
limitation: Cannot derive these reliably from outage notices alone.
